title: Running balance across three ordered events
method: Synthetic ledger amounts are 10, 20 and 5 units. Ordered cumulative sums are 10, 10+20=30 and 10+20+5=35. The first two timestamps tie; event_id supplies a deterministic secondary order and an explicit ROWS frame. No observed financial data.
alt: Running balance across three ordered events. Event 1: 10 units; Event 2: 30 units; Event 3: 35 units. Illustrative values.
